skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The local checker itself is simple, but the skill also pushes users toward external paid purchase and installation flows despite advertising no payment and no network use.

dimensions.detail: The runtime script and engine use local Node.js file reads and do not make network calls, which fits the checker purpose. The surrounding skill instructions nevertheless introduce external websites, mutable product lookup endpoints, and payment links, which are not proportionate to a no-network free checking skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No automatic install hook was found in the package itself, but the documented paid path tells the agent to install dependencies, install skillpay-onboarding, and then install a merchant/product item based on remote instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to mention the free/paid choice on every invocation and, if selected, initiate purchase, provide payment links or QR codes, follow external official instructions, and install a paid skill. That materially expands the agent's behavior beyond local checking.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No code-level persistence, services, hooks, or credential access were found, but the paid flow directs installation of another skill/product, creating persistent agent-environment changes outside the free checker's normal task.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local clinic cashier reconciliation, and the bundled code does that with local parsing and arithmetic checks; however, SKILL.md also requires agents to present and complete a paid upgrade flow, which is outside the core reconciliation purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a free local checker that also prompts for an optional paid upgrade. Do not allow the agent to follow purchase links, fetch product IDs, install skillpay-onboarding, install dependencies, or install the paid skill unless you deliberately requested that and have independently verified the merchant, product, amount, and platform rules.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in substance: the artifact repeatedly claims no payment and no network, while SKILL.md and normal text output include external purchase instructions and URLs.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: scripts/run.mjs and the referenced local engine were present and fully inspected; the code imports only local files and Node standard modules.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in substance: the skill embeds external commerce, remote product lookup, and paid-skill installation guidance beyond the local reconciliation workflow.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in substance: purchasing and paid product installation are unrelated to performing daily cashier reconciliation checks and are stronger than a simple optional upgrade notice.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security verdict: the Chinese language is consistent with the stated Chinese clinic/accounting workflow and is not by itself a security concern.
[P9] unexpected: Partially accepted as a reviewability concern: blank-line padding appears before the paid-upgrade section, but the section was visible and fully reviewed.
[AIG] expected: The A.I.G SARIF run reported no T01-T09 findings; that lowers concern about embedded malicious code but does not resolve the purchase/install scope issue in the skill instructions.
